Card Q&A.a: Yes, either can be unsuspended or suspended.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to unsuspend or suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may unsuspend 1 Digimon. Then, you may suspend 1 Digimon.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon suspend, you may play 1 3000 DP or lower green Digimon card with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits from your hand without paying the cost. For each suspended Digimon, add 2000 to this effect's DP maximum.
